claims.claim: The European Commission immediately suspended payments to Sierra Leone over Jos Leijdekkers, known as Bolle Jos.
claims.episode_span: The European Commission has immediately suspended payments to Sierra Leone over the fugitive Dutch national Jos Leijdekkers
claims.source_title: EU halts support to Sierra Leone over drug lord Bolle Jos
claims.supporting_quote: The European Commission has immediately suspended payments to Sierra Leone due to the fugitive Dutch drug lord Bolle Jos.

claims.claim: Sierra Leone stands to lose 18 million euros in budget support, and the Netherlands hopes a further 20.5 million euros can be halted next year.
claims.episode_span: stands to lose 18 million euros in budget support
claims.source_title: EU halts support to Sierra Leone over drug lord Bolle Jos
claims.supporting_quote: As a result, the Sierra Leone government stands to lose 18 million euros in budget support. The Netherlands hopes that a further 20.5 million euros in aid can be halted next year.

claims.claim: The European Parliament adopted a resolution on judicial cooperation with third countries that names Jos Leijdekkers, believed to be hiding in Sierra Leone.
claims.episode_span: The European Parliament has adopted a resolution calling for stronger judicial cooperation
claims.source_title: EU halts support to Sierra Leone over drug lord Bolle Jos
claims.supporting_quote: The resolution explicitly mentions the Dutch drug criminal Jos Leijdekkers, also known as Bolle Jos. The Bredan drug criminal is believed to be hiding in Sierra Leone.

claims.claim: Courts in Belgium and the Netherlands have sentenced Leijdekkers to more than 100 years in prison.
claims.episode_span: courts in Belgium and the Netherlands have sentenced him to more than 100 years in prison
claims.source_title: EU halts support to Sierra Leone over drug lord Bolle Jos
claims.supporting_quote: In Belgium and the Netherlands, Leijdekkers has been sentenced to more than 100 years in prison.

claims.claim: David van Weel said he was pleased with the suspension and frustrated that EU funds go to a country refusing extradition cooperation.
claims.episode_span: Van Weel told De Telegraaf he was pleased with the suspension
claims.source_title: EU halts support to Sierra Leone over drug lord Bolle Jos
claims.supporting_quote: "I am very pleased with this step," Van Weel told De Telegraaf. "It is frustrating that EU funds are going to a country that refuses to cooperate in the extradition of someone like Bolle Jos."
